title: Cookies
metaDescription: Cookie information for the St John's Park website.

sections.title: How this site uses cookies
sections.contentHtml:
This site is designed to stay lightweight and mostly static. We aim to use only the minimum technical cookies or browser storage needed for the site to function properly.

Embedded content from third-party services, such as Google Maps, may set their own cookies when you interact with them. Their cookie behaviour is controlled by those providers rather than by St John's Park.

If we add additional cookie-based features in the future, this page should be updated to reflect that clearly.
